abiJson.author: Hoppr
abiJson.description: Hoppr Genesis fixed-supply signed-quote NFT collection

declarations.name: ClaimWhitelist
declarations.description:
`proof` is a forward snake. Every cell stores one 256-bit sibling hash and
optionally references the next proof cell. Pair hashes are sorted.

declarations.name: HopprQuote
declarations.description:
Canonical quote payload. The signature is intentionally outside this cell.
Automatic Tolk serialization is the normative encoding and is mirrored by QuoteCodec.ts.
